<script>
(function () {
  var canvas = document.getElementById("topo-canvas");
  if (!canvas || !canvas.getContext) return;
  var ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;

  // ---- 1. A cheap stand-in for Perlin/simplex noise: sum a handful
  // of plane waves, each traveling at its own angle/frequency/speed.
  // Summed together they produce a smooth, organic-looking elevation
  // field — good enough to contour into a topo-map look without
  // pulling in a noise library for a small decorative canvas.
  var waves = [
    { angle: 0.3, freq: 0.05, amp: 1.0, speed: 0.15 },
    { angle: 2.1, freq: 0.035, amp: 0.7, speed: -0.1 },
    { angle: 4.0, freq: 0.08, amp: 0.5, speed: 0.22 },
    { angle: 1.2, freq: 0.022, amp: 0.9, speed: -0.08 },
    { angle: 5.4, freq: 0.06, amp: 0.4, speed: 0.3 }
  ];
  function heightAt(x, y, t) {
    var h = 0;
    for (var i = 0; i < waves.length; i++) {
      var w = waves[i];
      var d = x * Math.cos(w.angle) + y * Math.sin(w.angle);
      h += w.amp * Math.sin(d * w.freq + t * w.speed);
    }
    return h;
  }

  // Elevation-band colors, low to high, sweeping through the same
  // warm palette used by the Teaching page's Lorenz attractor so the
  // two generative-art hero visuals feel like a matched set.
  var levelColors = ["#7a1f2b", "#9c3a4a", "#b8623f", "#c9a227", "#d9b23a", "#d9808c", "#e8a0ac"];

  // ---- 2. Marching squares: the standard algorithm for turning a
  // grid of elevation values into contour lines at a given threshold
  // — literally how real topographic maps are generated from height
  // data. Each of the 16 possible corner configurations (based on
  // which corners are above/below the threshold) maps to 0, 1, or 2
  // line segments through that grid cell, interpolated along the
  // cell's edges for a smooth (not blocky) crossing point.
  function marchingSquares(grid, cols, rows, threshold) {
    var segments = [];
    function val(cx, cy) { return grid[cy * cols + cx]; }
    function interp(v1, v2) {
      if (Math.abs(v1 - v2) < 1e-9) return 0.5;
      return (threshold - v1) / (v2 - v1);
    }
    for (var cy = 0; cy < rows - 1; cy++) {
      for (var cx = 0; cx < cols - 1; cx++) {
        var tl = val(cx, cy), tr = val(cx + 1, cy), br = val(cx + 1, cy + 1), bl = val(cx, cy + 1);
        var idx = 0;
        if (tl > threshold) idx |= 8;
        if (tr > threshold) idx |= 4;
        if (br > threshold) idx |= 2;
        if (bl > threshold) idx |= 1;
        if (idx === 0 || idx === 15) continue;
        var top = [cx + interp(tl, tr), cy];
        var right = [cx + 1, cy + interp(tr, br)];
        var bottom = [cx + interp(bl, br), cy + 1];
        var left = [cx, cy + interp(tl, bl)];
        switch (idx) {
          case 1: segments.push([left, bottom]); break;
          case 2: segments.push([bottom, right]); break;
          case 3: segments.push([left, right]); break;
          case 4: segments.push([top, right]); break;
          case 5: segments.push([top, left], [bottom, right]); break;
          case 6: segments.push([top, bottom]); break;
          case 7: segments.push([top, left]); break;
          case 8: segments.push([top, left]); break;
          case 9: segments.push([top, bottom]); break;
          case 10: segments.push([top, right], [left, bottom]); break;
          case 11: segments.push([top, right]); break;
          case 12: segments.push([left, right]); break;
          case 13: segments.push([bottom, right]); break;
          case 14: segments.push([left, bottom]); break;
        }
      }
    }
    return segments;
  }

  // ---- 3. Resize / draw / animate — same shape as the Teaching
  // page's Lorenz attractor script, just with a re-evaluated height
  // grid each frame instead of a rotation angle.
  function resize() {
    var rect = canvas.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    var dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = rect.width * dpr;
    canvas.height = rect.height * dpr;
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    return { w: rect.width, h: rect.height };
  }

  var size = resize();
  var cellSize = 7;
  var currentT = 0;

  function draw(t) {
    var w = size.w, h = size.h;
    var cols = Math.ceil(w / cellSize) + 1;
    var rows = Math.ceil(h / cellSize) + 1;

    var grid = new Float32Array(cols * rows);
    var minH = Infinity, maxH = -Infinity;
    for (var gy = 0; gy < rows; gy++) {
      for (var gx = 0; gx < cols; gx++) {
        var hv = heightAt(gx * cellSize, gy * cellSize, t);
        grid[gy * cols + gx] = hv;
        if (hv < minH) minH = hv;
        if (hv > maxH) maxH = hv;
      }
    }

    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);

    var levels = levelColors.length;
    for (var l = 0; l < levels; l++) {
      var threshold = minH + (maxH - minH) * ((l + 1) / (levels + 1));
      var segs = marchingSquares(grid, cols, rows, threshold);
      if (!segs.length) continue;
      ctx.beginPath();
      for (var s = 0; s < segs.length; s++) {
        ctx.moveTo(segs[s][0][0] * cellSize, segs[s][0][1] * cellSize);
        ctx.lineTo(segs[s][1][0] * cellSize, segs[s][1][1] * cellSize);
      }
      ctx.strokeStyle = levelColors[l];
      ctx.lineWidth = 1.1;
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8;
      ctx.stroke();
    }
  }

  draw(currentT);

  if (!reduceMotion) {
    (function animate() {
      currentT += 0.02;
      draw(currentT);
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);
    })();
  }

  window.addEventListener("resize", function () {
    size = resize();
    draw(currentT);
  });
})();
</script>
